root_cause: The Escape key pressed on the access toggle button is intercepted by the dropdown's data-api keydown handler, which prevents event propagation and stops the modal from receiving the Escape key to close.
repair_strategy: Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to only handle the Escape key when the dropdown is open (isActive), allowing Escape to bubble up to the modal when the dropdown is closed.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will now close the share modal when focus is on the access button, providing a keyboard mechanism to dismiss the dialog as required.
functional_risks: Escape will no longer close the dropdown when it is closed (which is correct behavior per BS5).
If any custom code relies on Escape being captured by the dropdown regardless of its open state, that behavior will change.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape when the dropdown is open still closes the dropdown.
Verify that pressing Escape when the dropdown is closed closes the share modal.
Verify that ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Space keys continue to operate correctly for dropdown interaction.
Ensure no regression in other dropdown-related keyboard interactions.
